This is a reduced copy of [Luau](https://github.com/luau-lang/luau) at commit
`94c4916be84c1d6ef3d80fd28e032fed017b4854`.

Ferrum uses the Common, Ast, Bytecode, Compiler, and VM libraries to compile
and run material import scripts. The engine defines these targets in
`cmake/ThirdParty/luau.cmake`. Other upstream modules and tools are omitted.

See `LICENSE.txt` and `lua_LICENSE.txt` for license terms.
